description:
Mutate fields on an existing music/SFX track by id. Read existing tracks via `get_project.audio_tracks` — the per-entry shape there matches this tool's args, so you can flip a knob (volume, fades, timing, loop) and write it back without losing the track's id.

To change the volume over time inside one track — duck music under narration, swell between lines, ride a level — pass `keyframes`: `[{time, volume}]`, time in seconds from the track's start (not the project timeline: subtract the track's guide_start_time), volume 0-100, linear between points. Hold a level with two points at the same volume and ramp with two at different ones, e.g. full until 4s, down to 20 by 4.5s, back up from 11s to 11.5s: `[{time:0,volume:60},{time:4,volume:60},{time:4.5,volume:20},{time:11,volume:20},{time:11.5,volume:60}]`. Never split a track into pieces to change its level. `keyframes` replaces the track's whole list, so send every point you want kept (the current ones are in `get_project.audio_tracks[].keyframes`); `[]` removes them. While a track has keyframes they set its level and `volume` is not heard.

Only fields you pass are changed; omitted fields are preserved. To delete a track entirely, use `remove_from_project(target='audio')` instead. A track cannot be renamed (no name field here); to relabel one, remove it and re-add it with add_audio.

guide_end_time.description: New end time on the project timeline (seconds)

guide_start_time.description: New start time on the project timeline (seconds)

keyframes.description: Volume over time, linear between points. Replaces the track's whole keyframe list; [] removes it. A point past the track's end is moved to the end.

time.description: Seconds from the track's start (not the project timeline)

music_end_time.description: New end offset within the source file (seconds)

music_id.description: ID of the audio track (from get_project.audio_tracks[].id)

music_start_time.description: New start offset within the source file (seconds)

name: update_audio
title: Update an existing audio track
